root_cause: The delivery planner treated any executable path matching sharedPaths as global even when the same path already had an explicit lane owner. Because .github/workflows/ is shared, delivery-control workflow changes activated backend, portal, automation and website, including multi-minute browser assurance unrelated to the changed control plane.
prevention: Give explicit scopedLaneForPath and configured lane.paths ownership precedence over the generic shared-path fallback.
Register known delivery-control workflows and control-plane sources with their narrow backend or automation owner.
Preserve the conservative all-lane fallback for unknown workflow files so new workflow categories cannot silently lose assurance.

evidence.observed_reason: .github/workflows generic shared path overrode explicit delivery ownership

evaluation.expected: Known delivery-control workflow changes select only their explicit automation/backend owners; explicitly configured website/portal workflows select their own lane; unknown workflows still run all lanes.
